title: Depth Anything
hero_prompt: A wide ukiyo-e woodblock print in the Hokusai manner: a lone walker in the foreground, a bamboo grove behind, a mountain ridge far back, the three planes separating like sliding paper screens pulled apart, flat bold colour bands and woodblock grain, no signage, no seal stamp, no chop mark. Hand-made ukiyo-e woodblock print (Hokusai style), with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
icon_prompt: A bold woodblock emblem of three stacked overlapping silhouette bands receding in size, rendered as a stark high-contrast black-on-white mark. No fine linework, no letters or text — reads clearly at small size.
